
---

### Downloads

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `PhoneMic-*-android.apk` | The phone app. Android 8.0 or newer. |
| `PhoneMic-*-windows-x64.exe` | The PC app. Runs as is, nothing else to install. |
| `PhoneMic-*-windows-x64-requires-dotnet.exe` | The same PC app, 1 MB instead of 75, for machines with the [.NET 10 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0). |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums of the files above. |

The PC side also needs [VB-Audio Virtual Cable](https://vb-audio.com/Cable/) (free). Setup takes a minute: see the [README](https://github.com/shamil-aminov/PhoneMic#getting-started).
